correctness.rationale: Since n=p^e−1 is prime to p, the monomial power map [X:Y:Z]↦[X^n:Y^n:Z^n] is étale in the torus and has ramification only along coordinate axes. Its target conic Qλ=λ(U+V+W)^2+UV+VW+WU degenerates precisely λ=−1/3 when p≠3 (in p2 from derivatives); axis tangency occurs λ=−1/4 for odd p, while λ0 meets vertices. Else conic smooth, avoids vertices and meets axes transversely, so pullback is a smooth irreducible plane curve. At λ0 quadratic Cremona identifies Fermat normalization and ordinary n-fold vertex cones. Explicit cube-root-of-unity factorization gives two smooth degree-n Fermat components with n² transverse torus intersections; Heron factorization gives four smooth degree d=n/2 components, six pairs each meeting in d points on coordinate axes, 3n supports, local equation v²−u^n (A_{n−1}); all support is F_q rational. Independent exact factorization and finite-field Jacobian support tests over F2,F3,F5,F7 corroborate the algebraic argument.

value.rationale: A complete geometric singular-fiber stratification of a natural invariant pencil is a substantive algebraic-geometry invariant: components, genus normalizations, exact singular supports, tangency order and all-characteristic exceptions. It corrects an incorrect earlier blanket smoothness claim rather than merely tabulating a small numerical sample.

final_claim: For n=q−1, q=p^e, the pencil λ(X^n+Y^n+Z^n)^2+(XY)^n+(YZ)^n+(ZX)^n has exactly: zero Cremona-Fermat fiber with three ordinary n-fold vertices (n>1), split conic λ=−1/3 when p≠3 with two degree-n components and n² nodes, tangent conic λ=−1/4 when p≠2 with four degree-n/2 components and 3n A_{n−1} contact points, all other finite fibers smooth irreducible, infinity a double Fermat curve.
